referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Novak Painting Group Phoenix homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a warm-ivory editorial column with serif-style promise and embedded form is paired with a large refined living-room photograph. It uses thin black and gold utility navigation with a small estimate control. The visual system relies on high-contrast serif display paired with restrained readable sans; surfaces include warm ivory, near-black, white and accents include muted gold, sage, warm terracotta. Imagery is calm residential interiors, project thumbnails, and paint sample-like color strips. The page then runs through split interior and estimate hero, layered finish-method chapter, dark company statement, painting service cards, project photo row, Greater Phoenix area, dark contact form, FAQ, gold closing statement. Its service presentation is quiet bordered service cards after a color-layer preparation explanation. Mobile changes to place the form before the hero image, stack service cards, and preserve contrast across black and ivory chapters. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy Novak identity, home photography, reviews, gold-and-black trade dress, licensed claims, project names, or response-time claims.
